description: This file defines the 'Compiler' class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for compiling template nodes into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling Twig template nodes into PHP source code, managing indentation, debug info, and code generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Compiler with an Environment object.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current source code being compiled.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the compiler's internal state for a new compilation process.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a given Node object into PHP code with specified indentation.

methods.name: subcompile
methods.description: Sub-compiles a Node, optionally with raw indentation, appending to existing source.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Adds raw string to the compiled source code.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes strings to the source code with current indentation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Adds a quoted string to the source code, escaping as necessary.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into its code representation and adds it to the source.

methods.name: addDebugInfo
methods.description: Adds debugging information linked to a Node's template line.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for code generation.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level, throws exception if it would become negative.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique variable name for use in compiled code.

methods.name: checkForEcho
methods.description: Detects if a string contains an 'echo' or 'print' statement to flag usage in code.
